abort_philosophy: Fail-Safe Immediate Cutoff: Any integrity breach of safety perimeters or telemetry synchronization mandates instant cessation of the active trial and flags the recording as ABORTED.

abort_triggers.trigger_condition: Safety Marshal or vehicle operator depresses manual/wireless E-Stop button.
abort_triggers.system_response: Cut vehicle traction power instantly; log abort timestamp; flag active recording as ABORTED_SAFETY.

abort_triggers.trigger_condition: Optical tripwire, LiDAR curtain, or perimeter sensor detects uncertified human/object entering test buffer.
abort_triggers.system_response: Emergency vehicle halt; alarm sounding; immediate capture freeze.

abort_triggers.trigger_condition: Worker or visitor seen in camera field within 15m of vehicle dynamic envelope.
abort_triggers.system_response: Safety Marshal triggers remote E-Stop immediately; capture invalid.

abort_triggers.trigger_condition: Grandmaster loses GNSS lock or PTP slave transitions out of SLAVE_SYNCHRONIZED state.
abort_triggers.system_response: Abort trial run; reject active event; require clock re-lock and 5-minute burn-in.

abort_triggers.trigger_condition: Camera A, B, or C drops >= 1 frame or RTSP socket disconnection occurs.
abort_triggers.system_response: Abort trial run; discard current event from valid corpus; re-verify RTSP link.

abort_triggers.trigger_condition: CAN bus message gap > 20 ms for vehicle speed or brake state.
abort_triggers.system_response: Abort trial run; reject event package; check CAN transceiver.

abort_triggers.trigger_condition: Secondary LiDAR / radar stream dropout or packet loss exceeds 0.01%.
abort_triggers.system_response: Abort trial run; mark secondary zone as UNVERIFIED.

abort_triggers.trigger_condition: Optical flow or fiducial checkerboard detects camera mount vibration / shift > 0.5 degrees.
abort_triggers.system_response: Halt testing; invalidate extrinsic calibration; mandate full Total Station resurvey.

abort_triggers.trigger_condition: NVMe ingest buffer queue > 80% capacity or disk write latency > 50 ms.
abort_triggers.system_response: Gracefully pause testing until disk queues flush; reject incomplete event.

abort_triggers.trigger_condition: 10GbE switch port CRC error rate > 0 or packet retransmissions detected on PTP VLAN.
abort_triggers.system_response: Abort capture session; initiate switch diagnostic.
